facts.business: Jackson Investments Limited is engaged in investments and trading of shares and securities and other financial activities, meeting the criteria for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) under Section 45-IA of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

auditor.name: S P M L & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Mumbai (FRN - 136549W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Certain balances of trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances are subject to confirmation, reconciliation, and consequential adjustments. 2. Ongoing inquiry by Office of Registrar of Companies, West Bengal involving past loan receipt/payment matters. 3. Company meets criteria for NBFC registration under Section 45-IA of RBI Act, 1934 but has not obtained such registration. 4. Stock-in-trade of shares in listed companies not currently traded on any stock exchange valued at nominal value of INR 1 per share totaling INR 1.49 Lakhs. 5. Various advances given in past years recoverable in cash.

key_risks: Provisioning for Expected Credit Loss (ECL) involves significant management judgment and estimation uncertainty
Certain financial assets including advances for acquisition of shares and securities are pending settlement
Ongoing regulatory inquiry by Registrar of Companies, West Bengal
Non-compliance with NBFC registration requirement under RBI Act
Stock-in-trade valued at nominal value due to lack of trading on stock exchange
Balances of trade receivables, trade payables, and loans and advances subject to confirmation and reconciliation
